name: Parker Jones
story: Parker Jones helped organisations acquire and implement Esri software through Prime Computer and Eagle Technology during the late-1980s expansion of GIS in New Zealand. His sales, distribution and customer work formed part of the growing local GIS software business.
A Royal Society Wellington Branch biography describes Parker Jones’s role in selecting, importing, selling and supporting software, including Esri GIS.
